main_text.p: Genef.17.30. 1. Regum 1. Tob. 6. Luc.i; Pfalm.61. Sed generalis hinc doctrina colli-gi poteft, neminem ad Deum accedere pos-se,nisi qui fratribus suis conjunctus est,Matthaei 5. 6. Marc.11. Ergo sicuti haec ratio domesticas omnes turbas & jurgia debet com-ponere, ut in singulis familiis invocetur Deus: ita in communi omnium vita ad ri-xas omnes cohibendas quasi frænum esse debet. Sumus enim plus quàm insani,si viam nobis ad invocandum Deum scientes ac volentes præcludimus: quum sit hoc unicum salutis nostræ asylum. O Iesu Christe fili Dei unigenite, qui vis cunctos homines sal-vos fieri, & jubes nos invocare nomen tuum, da quod jubes, ac doce nos orare,& ef-funde super nos spiritum gratiæ & precum, ut tum precari, tum salvari possimus in nomine tuo sancto & salutifero,

page.notes: The first line reads "Luc.i;" in the scan; the final character may be a numeral 1, so it is not certain. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The catchword "Se-" is at the bottom right. The page is slightly skewed and the lower margin shows a dark mark at the left edge, which is not print.
